text.p: Keppel Integrated Engineering Ltd said on Thursday it expected an improvement in profits in 1997, despite a continued competitive business environment.

Its engineering division, which contributed 52 percent of the group's turnover in 1996, would continue to be busy with existing major contracts in Singapore, the company said in a statement accompanying its 1996 results.
It would also participate in tenders for infrastructural projects during the year, Keppel Integrated Engineering (KIE) said.
The contracting division's performance was unlikely to improve this year as the marine industry was expected to remain depressed in Singapore,it said.
In 1996, KIE achieved lower operating profits in the second half due to difficult market conditions, especially in the marine and related sectors.
KIE reported its net profit fell 24.7 percent to Singapore S$10.9 million in 1996 on turnover of S$314.25 million.
